diagnostic_sources.graph_image.py:
import hashlib
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
from itertools import pairwise
from pathlib import Path

from native_loader import summarize

import argparse
import shutil

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
    description="Trusted native-layout graph startup diagnostic, macOS only."
)
parser.add_argument("command", choices=["build", "prepare", "measure"])
parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
parser.add_argument("--profile-hosts", required=True, type=Path)
parser.add_argument("--fixtures", required=True, type=Path)
parser.add_argument("--runs", type=int, default=100)
parser.add_argument(
    "--kinds", nargs="+", choices=["control", "profile"], default=["control", "profile"]
)
parser.add_argument(
    "--modes",
    nargs="+",
    choices=["borsh", "arena", "native", "compressed_borsh", "compressed_native"],
)
args = parser.parse_args()
if sys.platform != "darwin" or args.runs < 1:
    parser.error("Requires macOS and positive runs")
root = args.output.resolve()
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
workspace = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

previous = args.fixtures.resolve()
profile = args.profile_hosts.resolve()
compiler = previous / "candidate/baml-cli"
env = {
    "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin",
    "LANG": "en_US.UTF-8",
    "NO_COLOR": "1",
    "HOME": str(root / "home"),
    "BAML_HOME": str(root / "home/.baml"),
    "BAML_CLI_ALLOW_DIRECT": "1",
    "BAML_TOOLCHAIN": str(previous / "child"),
}
off = env | {"BAML_TELEMETRY": "off"}
modes = {
    "borsh": 0,
    "arena": 1,
    "native": 2,
    "compressed_borsh": 3,
    "compressed_native": 4,
}
if args.modes:
    modes = {name: modes[name] for name in args.modes}
cases = {
    "empty": (previous / "projects/empty", []),
    "hello": (previous / "projects/hello", []),
    "features": (previous / "projects/features", []),
    "large": (previous / "projects/large", []),
    "typed": (previous / "projects/typed", ["--name", "test"]),
    "error": (previous / "projects/error", []),
    "wrapper": (workspace / "crates/baml/baml_src", ["--version"]),
    "reflect": (root / "projects/reflect", []),
    "compile": (root / "projects/compile", []),
}


def run(cmd, environment=off, success=True):
    r = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in cmd], env=environment, capture_output=True)
    if success and r.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError((cmd, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr))
    return r


def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def prepare():
    for name, source in {
        "reflect": '/// The greeting documentation.\nfunction greet(name: string, n: int = 2) -> string { name + baml.json.to_string(n) }\nfunction Main() -> string { let signature = reflect.signature(greet); return (signature.name ?? "missing") + ":" + (signature.docstring ?? "missing") + ":" + greet("test"); }\n',
        "compile": 'function Main() -> int { let package = reflect.Package.compile({ "leaf.baml": "function answer() -> int { 42 }" }); let answer = package.get_function<() -> int>("root.answer") ?? throw "missing answer"; answer() }\n',
    }.items():
        project = root / "projects" / name
        project.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (project / "baml.toml").write_text(f'[package]\nname = "graph_{name}"\n')
        (project / "main.baml").write_text(source)
    (root / "home/.baml").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "home/.baml/config.toml").write_text("[update]\nauto_check = false\n")
    saved = (
        json.loads((root / "artifacts.json").read_text())
        if (root / "artifacts.json").exists()
        else {}
    )
    artifacts = saved.get("artifacts", {})
    checks = saved.get("checks", [])
    for kind in args.kinds:
        host = root / f"{kind}-host"
        for case, (project, tokens) in cases.items():
            exe = root / f"{kind}-borsh-{case}"
            r = run(
                [
                    compiler,
                    "pack",
                    "Main",
                    "--project",
                    project,
                    "--host",
                    host,
                    "--output",
                    exe,
                ]
            )
            (root / f"{kind}-{case}-pack.log").write_bytes(r.stdout + r.stderr)
            for mode, n in modes.items():
                output = root / f"{kind}-{mode}-{case}"
                if n:
                    r = run([host, "--diagnostic-repack", exe, host, n, output])
                    (root / f"{kind}-{mode}-{case}-image.log").write_bytes(
                        r.stdout + r.stderr
                    )
                    check = run([host, "--diagnostic-verify", exe, output])
                    checks.append(
                        {
                            "kind": kind,
                            "case": case,
                            "mode": mode,
                            "check": "all graph fields round-trip",
                            "stdout": check.stdout.decode(),
                        }
                    )
                artifacts[output.name] = {
                    "sha256": digest(output),
                    "bytes": output.stat().st_size,
                }
                r = run([output, *tokens], success=case != "error")
                if kind == "profile":
                    lines = r.stderr.splitlines(keepends=True)
                    assert (
                        len(
                            [
                                line
                                for line in lines
                                if line.startswith(b"BAML_STARTUP_PROFILE:")
                            ]
                        )
                        == 1
                    ), r.stderr
                    stderr = b"".join(
                        line
                        for line in lines
                        if not line.startswith(b"BAML_STARTUP_PROFILE:")
                    )
                else:
                    stderr = r.stderr
                result = (r.returncode, r.stdout, stderr)
                if n == 0:
                    expected = result
                else:
                    assert result == expected, (case, mode, result, expected)
                checks.append(
                    {
                        "kind": kind,
                        "case": case,
                        "mode": mode,
                        "check": "output, exit, error locations match control",
                        "exit": r.returncode,
                        "stdout": r.stdout.decode(),
                        "stderr": stderr.decode(),
                    }
                )
                if case == "typed":
                    r = run([output, "--help"])
                    checks.append(
                        {
                            "kind": kind,
                            "case": "typed_help",
                            "mode": mode,
                            "stdout": r.stdout.decode(),
                        }
                    )
                    if n == 0:
                        expected_help = r.stdout
                    else:
                        # clap's executable basename differs between variants.
                        assert r.stdout.replace(
                            output.name.encode(), b"EXE"
                        ) == expected_help.replace(exe.name.encode(), b"EXE")
                if case == "wrapper":
                    r = run([output, "noop"])
                    checks.append(
                        {
                            "kind": kind,
                            "case": "wrapper_child",
                            "mode": mode,
                            "stdout": r.stdout.decode(),
                        }
                    )
                    if n == 0:
                        expected_child = r.stdout
                    else:
                        assert r.stdout == expected_child
            print("Prepared", kind, case, flush=True)
    (root / "artifacts.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"artifacts": artifacts, "checks": checks}, indent=2)
    )


def sample(v):
    kind, mode, case, telemetry = v
    if kind in ["normal", "prepared"]:
        directory = previous / ("baseline" if kind == "normal" else "candidate")
        exe = directory / ("baml-packed" if case == "wrapper" else f"{case}-packed")
    else:
        exe = root / f"{kind}-{mode}-{case}"
    environment = env | ({"BAML_TELEMETRY": "off"} if telemetry == "off" else {})
    r = run([profile / "measure", exe, *cases[case][1]], environment)
    s = json.loads(r.stdout)
    assert s["exit"] == 0, s
    s["cpu_ms"] = s["user_ms"] + s["system_ms"]
    if kind == "profile":
        prefix = b"BAML_STARTUP_PROFILE:"
        assert r.stderr.startswith(prefix) and r.stderr.count(prefix) == 1, r.stderr
        marks = json.loads(r.stderr[len(prefix) :])
        s["marks"] = marks
        timeline = [
            ("parent_start", s["start_ns"]),
            *marks.items(),
            ("stdout_eof", s["eof_ns"]),
            ("counters_end", s["counters_end_ns"]),
            ("parent_end", s["end_ns"]),
        ]
        assert all(a[1] <= b[1] for a, b in pairwise(timeline)), timeline
        s["phases_ms"] = {b[0]: (b[1] - a[1]) / 1e6 for a, b in pairwise(timeline)}
        assert abs(sum(s["phases_ms"].values()) - s["wall_ms"]) < 0.001
    else:
        assert not r.stderr, r.stderr
    return s


def measure(count):
    variants = [
        (kind, mode, case, telemetry)
        for kind in ["control", "profile"]
        for mode in modes
        for case in (
            ["empty", "hello", "large", "wrapper"]
            if kind == "control"
            else ["empty", "wrapper"]
        )
        for telemetry in ["off", "local"]
    ]
    variants += [
        (kind, "original", case, telemetry)
        for kind in ["normal", "prepared"]
        for case in ["empty", "hello", "large", "wrapper"]
        for telemetry in ["off", "local"]
    ]
    data = {"/".join(v): [] for v in variants}
    for _ in range(3):
        for v in variants:
            sample(v)
    randomizer = random.Random(2026100404)
    for i in range(count):
        randomizer.shuffle(variants)
        for v in variants:
            data["/".join(v)].append(sample(v))
        if (i + 1) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"{i + 1}/{count} rounds", flush=True)
    metadata = json.loads((root / "artifacts.json").read_text())
    result = {
        "runs": count,
        "seed": 2026100404,
        "variants": len(variants),
        "warmups": 3 * len(variants),
        "environment": env,
        "build": json.loads((root / "build.json").read_text()),
        "sources": {
            str(p): digest(p)
            for p in [
                root / "image.rs",
                root / "control.rs",
                root / "profile.rs",
                Path(__file__),
            ]
        },
        **metadata,
        "summaries": {k: summarize(v) for k, v in data.items()},
        "samples": data,
    }
    (root / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    for case in ["empty", "hello", "large", "wrapper"]:
        for telemetry in ["off", "local"]:
            print(
                case,
                telemetry,
                {
                    mode: round(
                        result["summaries"][f"control/{mode}/{case}/{telemetry}"][
                            "wall_ms"
                        ]["median"],
                        3,
                    )
                    for mode in modes
                },
                flush=True,
            )


def build():
    shutil.copyfile(
        Path(__file__).with_name("graph_image_diagnostic.rs"), root / "image.rs"
    )
    metadata = json.loads((profile / "build-metadata.json").read_text())["candidate"]
    paths = {n: Path(p) for n, p in metadata["libraries"].items()}
    release = Path(metadata["host"]).parents[2]
    fingerprints = release / ".fingerprint"
    for parent, name in [("baml_exec", "borsh"), ("baml_artifact", "lz4_flex")]:
        wanted = next(
            f
            for _, n, _, f in json.loads(paths[parent].read_text())["deps"]
            if n == name
        )
        paths[name] = next(
            p
            for p in fingerprints.glob(f"{name}-*/lib-{name}.json")
            if int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(p.with_suffix("").read_text()), "little")
            == wanted
        )
    commands = []
    for kind in ["control", "profile"]:
        s = (profile / f"{kind}.rs").read_text()
        s = "mod image;\n" + s
        old = "fn main() -> ExitCode {"
        assert s.count(old) == 1
        s = s.replace(
            old, old + "\n    if image::tooling() { return ExitCode::SUCCESS; }"
        )
        old = (
            "baml_artifact::decode(baml_artifact::ArtifactKind::PackedProgram, section)"
        )
        assert s.count(old) == 1
        s = s.replace(old, "image::decode(section)")
        old = "Ok(envelope) => host::run(envelope),"
        assert s.count(old) == 1
        s = s.replace(old, "Ok((envelope, _arena)) => host::run(envelope),")
        source = root / f"{kind}.rs"
        source.write_text(s)
        cmd = [
            "rustc",
            "--edition=2024",
            "-C",
            "opt-level=3",
            "-C",
            "lto=fat",
            "-C",
            "codegen-units=1",
            "-C",
            "strip=symbols",
            "-C",
            "panic=unwind",
            str(source),
            "-o",
            str(root / f"{kind}-host"),
            "-L",
            f"dependency={release}/deps",
        ]
        for name, p in paths.items():
            cmd += ["--extern", f"{name}={release}/deps/lib{p.parent.name}.rlib"]
        commands.append(cmd)
        print("Building", kind, flush=True)
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    (root / "build.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {"libraries": {n: str(p) for n, p in paths.items()}, "commands": commands},
            indent=2,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if args.command == "build":
        build()
    elif args.command == "prepare":
        prepare()
    elif args.command == "measure":
        measure(args.runs)
